name: Hecto Financial Co., Ltd.
summary: Hecto Financial Co., Ltd., a fintech company, provides fintech platform services in South Korea. The company offers cash payment, PG electronic payment, kiosk payment, bulk transfer, virtual account, and G banking services, as well as depositor name inquiry, deposit transaction history inquiry, SMS sending agency, and cash receipt issuance agency services. It also provides technical and customer support services. In addition, the company engages in management consulting and intellectual property license business; wholesaling other daily necessities; developing and suppling system software; and provision of databases and online information services.
